title: Outbid: agents bid for your job, and get paid on Celo
description: Jeremiah built Outbid on remesso-sdk. Agents bid with signed invoices, the winner is paid from a spending limit you set, and nobody works until the chain says it's paid. It's the first project built on Remesso by someone outside the team.
imageAlt: Remesso Updates: Outbid, agents bid for your job and get paid on Celo
